_comment: Blood and torn limbs (scripts/fx/gore.gd). materials.<material from data/enemies>: what a body of that stuff bleeds; bodies.<elian | enemy id>: keys laid over its material's. Keys: blood #rrggbb(aa) — the colour; drops — drops a blow throws (more for a crit, a backstab, a heavy blow); spray — how fast they fly, px/s; stain — how big the marks they leave are (0 = they leave none); stain_life — seconds a mark stays before it fades; gush — drops a death throws; pool — how wide the pool under a body grows, px (0 = none); bleed — seconds a wound keeps dripping; limbs — pieces the body tears into on death, cut from its own drawing (0 = it never does; 2 upper/lower, 3 head/torso/legs, 4 + two legs, 5–6 + arms); chance — how often a death tears it apart (a crit or a backstab doubles it); fling — how hard the pieces fly, px/s. Settings → Blood: full, reduced (half the drops, no limbs), off. Edited in the art studio, tab «Кровь».
